title: Notable Wednesday Option Activity: AFSI, AAPL, DAL
text: January 10, 2018 at 15:15 PM EST Notable Wednesday Option Activity: AFSI, AAPL, DAL Looking at options trading activity among components of the Russell 3000 index, there is noteworthy activity today in AmTrust Financial Services Inc (AFSI), where a total volume of 17,724 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 1.8 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 112.2% of AFSI's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 1.6 million shares..
